description: Cypress tests frontend behaviour in a browser. We will use a blank local practice page to learn queries, clicks, inputs and controlled network responses. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain click and check the effect

seo.title: Cypress Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Cypress with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
